name: canonicalizes whitespace before assigning stable IDs
input: two equivalent forms, one distinct form, and a snapshot

name: concurrent equivalent registrations share one ID
input: two threads registering whitespace variants together
test:
from threading import Barrier, Thread

registry = TemplateRegistry()
variants = ['  Summarize  this\n\n note ', 'Summarize this\r\n\r\nnote']
barrier = Barrier(len(variants))
results = [None] * len(variants)

def worker(index, template):
    barrier.wait()
    results[index] = registry.register(template)

threads = [Thread(target=worker, args=(index, template)) for index, template in enumerate(variants)]
for thread in threads:
    thread.start()
for thread in threads:
    thread.join(timeout=2)
assert all(not thread.is_alive() for thread in threads)
assert results == [0] * len(variants)
assert registry.snapshot() == ['Summarize this\n\nnote']

name: rejects invalid templates and IDs
input: empty canonical text, non-string templates, and invalid lookups
test:
def expect(exception_type, call):
    try:
        call()
    except exception_type:
        return
    raise AssertionError(f'expected {exception_type.__name__}')

registry = TemplateRegistry()
expect(TypeError, lambda: registry.register(3))
expect(ValueError, lambda: registry.register(' \t\r\n  '))
registry.register('ok')
expect(TypeError, lambda: registry.get(True))
expect(IndexError, lambda: registry.get(-1))
expect(IndexError, lambda: registry.get(2))
